license: Original scene and maps created for this repository; repository terms apply. No additional blanket CC0 grant.

crowd.sourceStatement: Repository render of fictional MakeHuman CC0 bodies and clothes. No real-player likeness, club emblem, brand, or live spectator photograph.
crowd.transformation: Deterministic Lanczos resample 1024x1152 -> 896x1008; RGBA alpha retained.
crowd.animation: Adjacent atlas cells switch between sitting/clapping and cheering; instanced per-person phase and slight sway.

runtime.construction: Merged static geometry per PBR material, one InstancedMesh for seats and one for fictional crowd.
runtime.videoCube: Four faces share one 768x384 canvas updated 6Hz
runtime.lighting: One 1024px directional shadow; one hemisphere, one directional fill, two unshadowed spots; roof fixtures emissive.
runtime.reflections: PBR ceiling-light environment with clearcoat, wood normal and worn-lane roughness plus one subtle baked lacquer sheen plane; no extra scene render.
runtime.roof: roofGroup may be hidden by broadcast camera to prevent foreground rafter occlusion.

export.excluded: Runtime instanced crowd/seats, animated video faces and lights. These are recreated by the module.
export.staticMaterials: Conventional PBR with local floor maps; see GLB report for compressed output.
